changelog:
Meta Agent Optimizer Free 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a closed-loop logging system for AI Agents, structuring three log categories: learnings, errors, and feature requests.
- Extracts reusable knowledge from both corrections and errors, minimizing repeated mistakes in agent evolution.
- Provides standardized log formats with unique ID generation and detailed metadata for each entry.
- Supports automatic detection triggers for corrections, feature requests, knowledge gaps, and error signals.
- Implements recurrence checks, status management, prioritization, and project-level knowledge promotion. 
- Designed for developers and teams to systematically record, review, and reuse AI Agent operational experience.
